title: Local N/O bond-formation competition in light-driven quinoxalinone alkylation
difficulty_reasons: Actual structures, reaction modes and comparable activation free energies must establish the local competition between N/O bond-formation pathways.
The observed N-alkylated product requires the correct connectivity and a valid minimum; the product observation alone does not establish the explanation.
Local site-selectivity evidence must be distinguished from a complete account of excited-state generation, ISC rates or precise yield.
